title: Team Stability: Theory and Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.19476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Teams emerge organically when individuals decide on their own their activities and collaborators. I develop and test a theory in which teams form with consent, interactions reflect team composition, and payoffs feature externalities and several forms of congestion. Stability constraints concern group interactions and require each team member to be willing to remain rather than withdraw or pursue a project alone.
